ai_executive_summary: We are doubling down on 'High-Velocity Relatability' by stripping away all academic nuance to focus exclusively on triggers that demand an immediate 'Me!' or 'Tag your teammate' reaction. Our strategy centers on physicalizing the mental glitches we all experience and the rivalries we all argue about.
self_learning_reflection: Previous attempts at educational content failed because they required cognitive labor; current 'glitch/rivalry' topics create instant emotional validation, which is the key to breaking the 10k-view barrier.

infinite_loop_directive: Ensure the last word of the video transitions back to the hook by asking a question that requires the viewer to loop the video to check if they missed the 'real' reason.
debate_bait_strategy: End each Short by asking a polarizing 'Which side are you on?' question that forces fans of opposing sports teams or regions to flood the comments to defend their position.
